{{Quote|Gidders is a good soldier. Blame for the operation under Black Crest is going to fall on him. I'm going to make his time in prison short and pleasant, and when he gets out he's going to be a rich man.|General Stavin Thaal on Gidders|<ref name="MK" />}}
'''Gidders''' was a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] in the [[Galactic Alliance Defense Force]] by [[44 ABY]]. He was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kuratooine]] when [[Turman Durra]], a member of [[Wraith Squadron]], appeared before the Alliance's military compound disguised as the ambassador of an underground species native to Kuratooine. For this, Gidders contacted [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]] about the jewels and valuables that "Embassy-Who-Climbs" had to offer in the underground caves that he and his people lived in, which was one of the reasons that lured Thaal over to Kuratooine.<ref name="MK" />

When Wraith Squadron caused trouble on the planet in order to attract enough attention to have Thaal arrested, the general considered blaming all the trouble on Gidders. After Thaal was apprehended for apparently being an imposter of himself, on account of genetically altering his appearance to be Thadley Biolan, Gidders was angry for what Thaal planned to do to him so he cooperated with the Alliance investigators which led to arrest of [[Borath Maddeus]], Thaal's partner.<ref name="MK" />
